jobs.title: Senior Director, Growth Marketing SVOD
jobs.description:
TELLING CAPTIVATING STORIES TO AUDIENCES EVERYWHERE
  
**Blue Ant Media (TSX:** BAMI) is an international streamer, production studio, advertising sales and rights\-management business. The company operates a diverse portfolio of free streaming and pay TV channels internationally, including Love Nature, Cottage Life, Smithsonian Channel Canada, BBC Earth Canada, HauntTV, Homeful, and Love Pets, as well as the subscription streaming service MagellanTV. Its studio business produces and distributes a wide range of premium content across key genres for streaming and broadcast platforms worldwide. Blue Ant Media is headquartered in Toronto, with a presence in Los Angeles, New York, Miami, Singapore, London, Washington, Sydney, Halifax, and Ottawa. blueantmedia.com⼁Instagram⼁LinkedIn
  
Our employees are passionate experts in all of our business areas. They are fanatical about creating outstanding content and experiences, and about delivering them on new and evolving platforms. We actively seek new employees who embody our core values. We want them to think big, act with purpose, celebrate creativity, do the right thing, respect one another, and succeed together. We attract creative talents who are optimistic about the evolving future of content and who take pride in recognizing opportunities where others see challenges. At Blue Ant Media, we give them the flexibility to think like entrepreneurs, take ownership of their projects, take risks, and embrace innovation in a rapidly evolving media landscape. Our team members excel at collaborating with internal and external partners by building trusting, respectful working relationships.
  
  

Senior Director, Growth Marketing, SVOD
  
Blue Ant Media is looking for a highly analytical, commercially minded and performance\-driven Senior Marketing Director to lead performance marketing across the business.
  
This is an exciting opportunity for a growth\-oriented marketing leader to help accelerate our SVOD growth, primarily in the US, while supporting expansion into new international markets and lines of business.
  
The Senior Director, Growth Marketing will own the end\-to\-end marketing function, with a mandate to drive subscriber acquisition, define and optimize marketing investment, improve customer conversion and maximize subscriber lifetime value. This role will oversee the full subscriber marketing funnel, from awareness and acquisition through conversion, engagement, retention and winback.
  
**We are looking for a true performance marketing expert:** someone who is exceptionally analytical, comfortable working with complex data, and passionate about translating insights into measurable business results. They will bring a test\-and\-learn mindset, a deep understanding of digital acquisition and subscription economics, and the ability to balance short\-term performance with sustainable long\-term growth.
  
While performance marketing is at the heart of this role, experience developing brands and building integrated marketing strategies will be a valuable asset.
  
This new role will report to the SVP, Marketing, Consumer Brands and is a hybrid position requiring in\-office attendance at our head office in Toronto for a minimum of three (3\) days per week.
  
The anticipated salary range for this role is $150,000 – $170,000 per year, with final compensation determined by experience and qualifications.
  
Core Responsibilities \& Duties
  
Growth and Performance Marketing
  
* Develop and lead the overall marketing strategy and growth plan, with subscriber growth and revenue as primary objectives.
* Own the subscriber acquisition strategy, driving efficient and scalable growth through paid media, digital channels and other acquisition opportunities.
* Establish and manage key performance metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates, return on ad spend (ROAS), subscriber lifetime value (LTV), retention and churn.
* Drive continuous optimization of marketing investment, ensuring budgets are allocated to the channels, audiences and campaigns delivering the strongest business results.
* Identify opportunities to improve the full acquisition funnel, from initial engagement through trial, subscription conversion and ongoing customer value.
* Lead a rigorous test\-and\-learn approach across creative, messaging, audiences, landing pages, offers, channels and campaign strategies.
* Use data, analytics and customer insights to identify growth opportunities, understand performance drivers and inform strategic decisions.


Customer Journey, Engagement and Retention
  
* Oversee the customer lifecycle marketing strategy, ensuring a cohesive and effective journey from prospect to subscriber to loyal customer.
* Drive the development and optimization of CRM initiatives, including email and push notifications, to improve conversion, engagement, retention and reactivation.
* Leverage customer segmentation, behavioural insights and performance data to deliver relevant, personalized communications.
* Identify opportunities to reduce subscriber churn, increase engagement and maximize customer lifetime value.
* Ensure acquisition and lifecycle marketing strategies work together to deliver sustainable subscriber growth.


Marketing Strategy and Brand Development
  
* Develop a cohesive marketing strategy that supports positioning, audience growth and commercial objectives.
* Ensure brand strategy, creative development and campaign messaging are informed by audience insights and performance data.
* Partner with internal programming, creative, product and commercial teams to develop compelling campaigns that drive awareness, consideration and subscription.
* Identify opportunities to build brand awareness and strengthen our competitive position in the US streaming market.
* Support the development and execution of marketing strategies for new international markets, adapting channel mix, audience targeting and messaging to local market dynamic

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Change Office
jobs.description:
OPENTEXT \- THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  

AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  

YOUR IMPACT
  
  

As the Senior Director, Change Office, you will establish and lead a global change management program supporting OpenText’s enterprise transformation, workplace strategy, real estate programs, and portfolio optimization.
  
You will own the change strategy, governance, and employee transition outcomes associated with new ways of working. Partnering with executive leadership and teams across HR, Workplace Experience, Corporate Communications, IT, Security, Legal, Finance, and regional Facilities, you will ensure major changes are supported by coordinated communications, clear timelines, and structured transition plans.
  
  

WHAT THE ROLE OFFERS
  
  

* Define and lead OpenText’s Global Change Management Framework, establishing consistent standards, governance, escalation protocols, and decision\-making practices.
* Create a comprehensive Change Playbook with practical templates, readiness assessments, implementation checklists, and transition tools.
* Build, develop, and lead a small team of change management experts, establishing clear roles, regional coverage, and scalable ways of working.
* Serve as the central coordination point across senior leadership, business leaders, and functional partners, aligning responsibilities, dependencies, and timelines.
* Lead cross\-functional steering groups, drive accountability for commitments, and proactively escalate risks and issues.
* Partner with Corporate Communications and HR to develop integrated change and communication plans, including executive announcements, FAQs, and employee transition updates.
* Lead change planning for office openings, closures, consolidations, relocations, and internal team moves.
* Coordinate employee readiness activities with construction, technology, security, facilities, and operational schedules.
* Establish feedback channels, readiness assessments, and post\-transition reviews that improve employee adoption and future change programs.
* Identify and mitigate organizational, operational, and communication risks while supporting contingency planning and business continuity.
* Maintain a global change dashboard, define meaningful KPIs, and provide regular progress and performance reporting to executive leadership.


WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Organizational Development, Human Resources, Communications, Real Estate, or a related discipline.
* 10 or more years of experience in change management, enterprise transformation, corporate real estate, or a related field, including leadership of complex global programs.
* Demonstrated experience establishing enterprise change frameworks, governance models, and scalable change management practices.
* Proven ability to build and lead a high\-performing team of change professionals.
* Strong executive presence, with the ability to influence senior leaders and drive accountability without direct reporting authority.
* Experience leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives across multiple regions, functions, and stakeholder groups.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* A strategic and employee\-focused approach, balanced with strong operational discipline and attention to execution.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, and project management platforms.
* Familiarity with Power BI is an asset.
* Prosci, PMP, or an equivalent change management or project management certification is considered an asset.


ONE LAST THING
  
  

OpenText is more than just a corporation. It is a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned. This is an opportunity to establish a global Change Office, influence enterprise\-wide transformation, and create a consistent, employee\-focused approach to how significant change is planned, communicated, and delivered.
  
  

OpenText's commitment to diversity and inclusion surpasses legal requirements, evident in ourEqual Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy which promotes a respectful and empowering environment for employees of all backgrounds, culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
  

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a ticket atAsk HR. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

jobs.title: Head of Data & Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
Department IT
Location Montreal
At Stingray, creativity, collaboration, and innovative technology are the pillars of our DNA. Are you ready to rock your career by joining a growing company, a team of music enthusiasts in a stimulating and fun work environment?


We are looking for a **Head of Data \& Business Intelligence** to join our Data \& Business Intelligence team. This position reports to the **Director of Software Development Unit – Internal Tools.**


As Head of Data \& Business Intelligence, you will drive the technical data vision and strategy for the entire organization. A deeply technical leader, you will have an in\-depth command of the systems, architecture, and automations that power our data. Your role will be to keep growing the strategic value of our data, maintaining alignment between our technological capabilities and business objectives. You will act as a key leader in the continued evolution of our culture and practices, connecting technical teams and leadership.


### **Your day\-to\-day**


* **Define the strategic vision:** Develop and drive the roadmap for data architecture, technology, and warehousing
* **Champion data culture:** Promote the importance of data quality, standardize definitions, and implement clear processes to shift the organization toward a predictive approach
* **Guide and unify teams:** Lead, mentor, and ensure effective collaboration between local and remote data teams, prioritizing high\-impact business initiatives
* **Ensure technical excellence:** Oversee the design of a reliable and high\-performing data ecosystem, while directly contributing (approximately 30%) to the design of systems, architectures, and automations to stay connected to ground\-level realities
* **Agentic leadership:** Guide a team already working with agentic development as it migrates our processes onto our in\-house agentic platform, putting in place what makes those automations trustworthy: validation, observability, guardrails, and governance
### **Your qualifications**


* Over 10 years of experience in data, business intelligence, and analytics, including team management
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex business objectives into a clear technical vision and strategic roadmap
* Strong leadership experience, with a talent for mentoring, change management, and aligning multidisciplinary teams, including data science and data engineering
* Proficiency in data architecture concepts (Data Mesh, Data Lakehouse, ETL/ELT, streaming, Pub/Sub) and Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
* In\-depth command of systems and architecture concepts, with the ability to design end\-to\-end solutions and assess their robustness
* Mastery of agentic development and automated software production pipelines (agent orchestration, evaluation, observability, guardrails), and a proven ability to lead a team working this way
* Ability to build well\-founded trust in automated systems: measuring their reliability, understanding their limits, and keeping human judgment where it matters
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization
* Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken, with strong spoken fluency in both languages
### **Nice\-to\-haves**


* Hands\-on experience managing the merger of technology stacks and teams
* Knowledge of data ecosystems and technologies (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Apache Beam, DBT, Google Cloud Dataflow, Tableau, etc.)
* Experience with the advertising data industry (SSAI, SSP, DSP)
* Ability to design business intelligence strategies tailored to different business models (e.g., subscription services, advertising)
* Knowledge of various programming and database languages (Python, Java, Rust, SQL, etc.)
### **The Team You Will Join**


* A technical Data \& Business Intelligence team of 8 people, including a technical lead and a project manager in Montreal
* Collaboration with a remote data science team \& a remote data engineering team
* Collaborative work with leaders across the entire company
### **Life at Stingray**


* A cool office in Montreal with the flexibility to work from home on Fridays
* Stingray café with breakfasts, lunches and snacks offered every day
* A subsidy for your OPUS card to make your commutes easier
* Shares purchase plan (with a contribution from Stingray)
* Full access to the Dialogue virtual healthcare platform
* Free fitness classes offered weekly
* Access to private consultations on nutrition and wellness
* Free language classes, training and access to the latest AI technologies and platforms to boost your productivity and creativity
* Summer hours
* Milestones celebrated with our loyalty program
* 5@7 and vibrant social events
* And much more!
We leverage AI‑supported tools to assist with the initial review of applications. These tools do not replace human judgment—final decisions are made by our recruitment teams.


Montreal\-based Stingray Group is a leading music, media and technology company with over 1,200 employees worldwide. Our offices are located in the **Old Port of Montreal** just minutes from the Lachine Canal bike path, a prime location for picnics or a jog at lunch time.


Stingray supports the principles of Employment Equity and is committed to ensuring our workforce is representative of the communities we serve and in which we operate. Women, Aboriginal peoples, persons with disabilities and visible minorities are encouraged to apply and to self\-identify so we can work towards full representation of those groups within our company.


Not the job for you? Go to jobs.stingray.com to consult other available positions and learn more about Stingray, we’re always on the lookout for new talent.
